note.en: A tiny lucine of sand and rubble, listed in the REGAMA catalogue as Ctena pectinella; two museum samples near Cahuita.
note.es: Una lucina diminuta de arena y escombros, citada en el catálogo del REGAMA como Ctena pectinella; dos muestras de museo cerca de Cahuita.

evidence: GBIF: 2 record(s) in the region, mostly museum specimens (Universidad de Costa Rica collections)

sources.t: Espinosa & Ortea 2001, Moluscos del mar Caribe de Costa Rica (REGAMA and Cahuita catalogue), Avicennia
